about: Part 05 section E: period level ranges, dead Catacombs rows, stonebreakers, Stoppered Wondrous Potion, duplicate deliver items, night-only wells (E2 is in d-rewards.json with D3; E4 skipped)

entries.why: Outcast Ormgarth used the patch 1.75b range 22-32 (grey target, Ormgarth L5); Prima Revised quest table '6 Outcast Ormgarth' (Atlas 'Outcast Ormgarth (lvl 6)'), period reward Snake Charm level 5
The Hunt for Arachneida used the patch 1.75b range 20-30; Prima Revised quest table '14 The Hunt For Arachneida' (Atlas 'lvl 14'); its period rewards are level 14
Supplies for Lillian used the patch 1.76 minimum 28; Prima Revised quest table '15 Supplies For Lillian' (Allakhazam 147: done at level 15, Scraek blue at 15)
Dugan's Magical Totem used minimum 24; Prima Revised quest table '19 Dugan's Magic Totem' (Urfgrat Prima [17], reward Skull-shaped Totem level 19)

the Blackened Mantle (level 28, Con 15 Dex 15 Hits 24) is the patch 1.94 reward 'adjusted to be more appropriate to its level' 28 (Allakhazam 147; item id 24141 has no period capture); the period reward is the Blackened Hammer ('she rewarded me with a Blackened Hammer', done at level 15), so with the period level 15 only the hammer is offered

entries.sql: UPDATE DataQuest SET StepText = replace(StepText, ' (Blackened Hammer, Blackened Mantle).', ' (Blackened Hammer).'), SourceText = replace(SourceText, '[Blackened Hammer], [Blackened Mantle].', '[Blackened Hammer].') WHERE ID = 20640
entries.why: the reward step no longer lists the post-period Blackened Mantle (patch 1.94); only the period Blackened Hammer is offered
Cad Goddeau B rows for Vampiir (58) and Bainshee (39): Cad Goddeau A has no row for those classes, so they can never be offered, and both are post-1.65 Catacombs classes

entries.sql: UPDATE DataQuest SET TargetName = replace(TargetName, '|granite giant stoneshaper;1|', '|granite giant stonebreaker;1|') WHERE ID = 20702 AND TargetName LIKE '%|granite giant stoneshaper;1|%'
entries.why: step 2 text and the period (Allakhazam 2040) name the granite giant stonebreaker; the step counted stoneshapers. Stonebreakers now stand at the period spot
step-2 marker now points at the stonebreakers at Dartmoor loc 11k,43k (Allakhazam 2040)

Black Plague's step-8 hand-in was an invented 'Malroch's Ladle'; the period item is the Stoppered Wondrous Potion (Allakhazam 1793: Sister Elaydith 'Do you have the Stoppered Wondrous Potion?'). v2: use the existing cq_stoppered_wondrous_potion that the Midgard (21245) and Hibernia (21425) Black Plague rows already use, instead of renaming the ladle into a second item of the same name
the step-8 lost-item check follows the hand-in to the shared Stoppered Wondrous Potion (Malroch the Cook stays the issuer)
step 4 (deliver the sealed letter) handed out a second sealed letter as it began although step 2's kill already dropped it; CollectItemTemplate keeps the hand-in
a player who lost the sealed letter still gets it back (the scout is a monster issuer, so it is re-issued) now that step 4 no longer hands out a copy
step 9 (return the journal) handed out a second Brother Codeth's Journal as it began although step 1's Give already did; CollectItemTemplate and the step-9 NeedsItem keep the hand-in
step 6 (return the soul stone) handed out a second empty soul stone as it began although step 4's Grant from Mystemas already did; CollectItemTemplate and the step-6 NeedsItem keep the hand-in
